description.value:
Cannith created many prototype warforged throughout the war. Many of them were experiments into advanced capabilities for war, some with more complex civilian purposes in mind. For whatever reason - whether the cost of production was prohibitive, or the capabilities did not meet expectations, or the war ended too soon - these Prototype Warforged were never released to the outside world of Khorvaire.

 

As unique warforged design, work with your GM to figure out what you were created for. Select an integrated armour type, and you become trained in a skill and a 1st level skill feat associated with that skill.
